svg.title: N-squared interface matrix of the machining FMS starting kit (16 modules, 51 interfaces)
svg.text: N² interface matrix – machining FMS kit (16 modules, 51 interfaces from item1_examples.json)
Row = module that owns / provides the interface, column = partner. Every filled cell needs one interface sheet (or one line in the common sheet for S, D, N).
these need a full interface sheet
S, D, N follow the common standards:
Expansion rules: '*' = every kit module except M19–M22; '*physical' = every module with moving parts (not M09, M19–M22); '*networked' = every module with a controller except M02. Self-pairs excluded.
